location.provenance: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to product safety.

status.provenance: Approved by Governor October 5, 2021. Filed with Secretary of State October 5, 2021.

pfas_definition.value: a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom
pfas_definition.provenance: Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or 'regulated PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: On and after July 1, 2023, a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer, shall not sell or distribute in commerce in this state any new, not previously owned, juvenile product that contains regulated PFAS chemicals.

exceptions: A children's electronic product, including, but not limited to, a personal computer, audio and video equipment, calculator, wireless phone, game console, handheld device incorporating a video screen, or any associated peripheral such as a mouse, keyboard, power supply unit, or power cord.
